chunks: (Even though) each miracle that We showed them was greater than the other. So We seized them with chastisement so that they may turn back.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says each miracle was greater than the other?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the progressive nature of divine signs (Ayat), where each manifestation was superior to the last, yet the disbelievers' stubbornness persisted despite clear evidence. The phrase 'we seized them with punishment' is interpreted not merely as retribution but as a merciful corrective measure intended to awaken their dormant faith and guide them back to the straight path.
